caption: The E. Barrett Prettyman United States Court House in Washington, D.C.
alt: Color photograph of the entrance of a stone federal courthouse building, with the words E. BARRETT PRETTYMAN UNITED STATES COURT HOUSE carved above three glass doors, flanked by trees.
credit: Photo by Tony Webster, via Wikimedia Commons / Flickr, CC BY 2.0
note: No period photograph of the courthouse or portrait of Judge Gerhard Gesell was found under a usable licence. This is a modern photograph of the same courthouse (US District Court for the District of Columbia) where the case was decided in 1968; the building predates the case.
